speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Altitude 2,500 meters. Approaching the Citadel Spire exterior flank. Wind gusts exceeding 65 knots. Automated perimeter flak batteries are tracking our trajectory.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: Target lock detected on our port engine! Raising forward solar barrier to absorb their heavy flak bursts. Keep us steady in the turbulence!

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Look at that monolithic wall of armor plating... Catwalks sighted at Gantry Level 42. Narrow maintenance rails running straight up the hull.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: The shear winds out there will rip a mech clean off the wall. Magnetize your boot solenoids and check your harness tethers!

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: Thermal exhaust vents along the ascent shaft are venting sub-zero cryogenic coolant. Surfaces will be slick with black ice.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: Citadel security mainframe is alerting all defensive automated drone wings. Aerial interceptors are launching from exterior silo racks above us!

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Cargo bay depressurized. Side ramps deploying. Once you drop onto the gantry, I will take the gunship into high-orbit cloud cover to evade anti-air destruction.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: One-way drop. We scale the Spire exterior on foot, punch through the blast doors into the Cyber-Nexus, or fall into the abyss.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Axiom Force! Weapons armed, grapples locked! Leap to the catwalks and begin the ascent! BREACH NOW!
